summary: Create a registry service account at access.redhat.com/terms-based-registry/accounts to get a generated username and token for registry_username and registry_password.
questions: How do I get registry_username and registry_password for AAP?
How do I create a Red Hat registry service account?
Registry token for containerized AAP install

answer_card.title: Get registry credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Go to https://access.redhat.com/terms-based-registry/accounts and click **New Service Account**.
2. Name it and click **Create**.
3. Open the account: the token page shows a **generated username** (not the account name) and a **token**.
4. Use them as `registry_username` and `registry_password`.
